w: Alex Malamy's malt-boiled, hearth-baked bagels — the Dodo Bagels pop-up turned Baltimore Ave shop (2023); on the Infatuation's 20 best in West Philly and Philly Mag's best-bagels guide for its mad-scientist sandwiches.
dish: The Ramen Thing bagel sandwich; everything and sesame bagels

w: Halal Indian barbecue in Southwest Philly — twenty items on the grill menu, skillets of whole charred fish and lamb chops, mains under $20; on the Infatuation's West Philly 20 and Visit Philly's 12 best Indian restaurants.

w: Hayat Alif's bright Ethiopian café-grocery at 45th & Baltimore (2020) — the traditional coffee ceremony, injera wraps of kitfo and collards; Billy Penn and the Inquirer's Cedar Park guide, ranked by Food & Wine among Philly's best lunches. Sister of Doro Bet.
dish: Ethiopian coffee ceremony; kitfo-and-collard injera wrap

w: Olney BYOB that the Infatuation calls Philly's best Haitian restaurant — griot, pwason fri, black rice and soup joumou; went viral for feeding neighbours its unsold food and became the diaspora's 2026 World Cup hub (WHYY, Billy Penn).
dish: Griot (fried pork) with pikliz; pwason fri; diri djon djon (black rice)

w: Kurt Evans's Strawberry Mansion pizzeria that employs only formerly incarcerated people — Detroit-style pies named to the NYT's 2021 list of America's 50 most vibrant restaurants, Philly Mag Best of Philly (pizza), LaBan's new-pizza roundup and a Hulu documentary.
dish: Detroit-style square pie with caramelized-cheese crust

address: 4600 N Broad St (at Belfield Ave), Philadelphia, PA 19140
w: The hot-pink Broad Street takeout window Sid 'Colonel of Shrimp' Booker opened in 1966 — battered shrimp baskets until the small hours; the 4600 block is co-named Sid Booker Way (2023). Infatuation North Philly guide, Philly Mag 'Eat This Now', Inquirer.
dish: Fried shrimp basket with fries and hot sauce

w: Corner Puerto Rican restaurant on Fifth Street, the main artery of El Centro de Oro — Visit Philly's El Centro de Oro guide and the Inquirer's neighbourhood guide to Philadelphia's Latino heart.
dish: Pernil with arroz con gandules; mofongo

w: El Centro de Oro's favourite Puerto Rican pastries, baked by a Mexican chef at a Brazilian-owned shop — quesitos, pan sobao, pastelillos de guayaba and pan de agua (Inquirer neighbourhood guide; Visit Philly El Centro de Oro guide).
dish: Quesitos and pastelillo de guayaba; pan de agua

w: Raquel Villanueva Dang's Filipino café-market in Brewerytown (opened Feb 2025) — LaBan called it 'a bright new voice in Philly's Filipino scene'; Philly Mag's comfort-and-charm feature and the Infatuation's North Philly guide.
dish: Longsilog and tocino breakfast plates; ube pastries

address: 1539 Cecil B. Moore Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19121

dish: Breakfast classics — runny eggs, crispy bacon and home fries

w: Olney's original Korean grill (1982) in a drafty old diner car on North Fifth Street, still dropping cast-iron grates straight onto live charcoal — LaBan's Olney Korean-BBQ standard-bearer, Philly Mag, the Infatuation's North Philly guide.
dish: Charcoal-grilled galbi and bulgogi with banchan

dish: Fruited sours and hazy IPAs

address: 208 Carter Dr, Suite 2, West Chester, PA 19382
w: West Chester brewery born from two friends' homebrewing — a dozen-plus drafts heavy on New England and double IPAs and big stouts, dog-friendly taproom; Visit Philly's 15 essential breweries, Philly Mag, Inquirer.
dish: New England double IPAs and pastry stouts

address: 2616 E County Line Rd, Ardmore, PA 19003
w: Italian specialty market founded by Nicola and Angela Carlino in 1983 — prepared foods, breads, cheeses and focaccia stuffing; Main Line Today's Best Deli 2026 and a 2026 Inquirer 'Main Line mainstay' profile.

address: 604 W Lancaster Ave, Bryn Mawr, PA 19010
w: Sandra Stauffer's Bryn Mawr bakery (c.1990), a Thanksgiving-pie institution — Main Line Today's Best Bakery 2026, Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Pies), Inquirer's seven great suburban bakeries.

w: Tired Hands' production brewery and 180-seat taproom in a century-old Ardmore trolley-repair shop, with a 36-seat viking table — the cult saison/IPA brewer's flagship now that the original 16 Ardmore Ave brewpub went private-events-only (Inquirer, Feb 2026). LaBan's best brewpubs, Inquirer Main Line breweries 2025, Main Line Today, Visit Philly's walk-from-Regional-Rail breweries.

w: Port Richmond Puerto Rican restaurant glowing with island flavour and culture — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Puerto Rican Restaurant), the Inquirer's 2022 profile, the Infatuation's best Puerto Rican spots for its pernil, and 6abc.

w: Amy Rivera's pop-up-to-storefront Puerto Rican turnover shop in Fishtown — on Esquire's 2024 best new restaurants in America; Infatuation ('worth the line, every time'), Philly Mag, Inquirer (now a Sixers partner, Sep 2026).

w: Tired Hands Brewing's Fishtown bar (2020) — the cult Ardmore brewer's only Philadelphia outpost, its saisons and IPAs on draught and to go; Inquirer, Philly Mag and PhillyVoice coverage, still open per the Inquirer's Feb 2026 Tired Hands report.

w: James Nardone's 16-seat Italian tasting-menu BYOB inspired by his grandmother — LaBan's 2024 round-up of three Italian tasting-menu splurges redefining Italian dining; on the Infatuation's 15 best in Fishtown.

dish: Pepperoni and tomato-pie slices

address: 2302 E Norris St (at Tulip St), Philadelphia, PA 19125
w: Corner-storefront pasta and wine bar from Waywine Vineyards' crew — LaBan's 'Fishtown hit' review praises the ruffled mafalde and beet-pink ravioli with Pennsylvania wines; on the Infatuation's 15 best in Fishtown.
